description: Colour schemes and characters -- navigator/styles/themes/*.nss generated by tools/palconv.py from DOS Navigator .PAL palettes, the 144-slot table from DN.DNR, LIVE/HAND_NAMED/DERIVED/DEPARTURES, palette pinning (VGA_PALETTE, --palette, NAVKIT_PALETTE, --reprogram-palette), colour quantisation in render_diff, glyph tiers (ascii/unicode/nerd, --glyphs, NAVKIT_GLYPHS), box charsets, the Nerd Font icon gutter, and file-type row colours (navigator/lib/appearance/filetypes.py). Use when changing a colour, a theme, an icon or a frame character.
